title: Enumeration - battle-logic (AI and gambit) target condition ids

container.notes: Enumeration spec: no file of its own. The pseudo-record describes how an id stored in a u16 field of other formats splits into bit fields; the enums give the labels.

records.name: conditionId
records.count: one per field that holds a battle-logic condition id
records.where: Any u16 typed as a battle-logic target condition: ARD section 3 caseNTargetCondition, battlepack section 7 caseNTargetCondition.

roundTrip: Store the id as a plain u16; the bit split is a reading aid.
Flipping bit 8 turns a test into its opposite; ids whose inverted twin is missing from the list (e.g. class 13 has 6 positive but 1 inverted label) are not known to work.
The (p) of a condition is the case parameter word next to it; keep it consistent with the condition (meters, percent, group number).
gaps: The Toolkit list has 2038 labels; the Toolkit reference speaks of 2,053 (TK L1291). The sheet's Data tab was only readable for its first rows.
Label conflict: 775 (0x0307) is "Furthest" in the Vanilla AI Scripts sheet but "Nearest" in the Toolkit list (0x0207 = Furthest); the bit structure supports the Toolkit.
Operand tables of the stat classes (class 1: which operand is which stat beyond those labelled) come only from the labels.
